correctness.rationale: The candidate RESULT.md defines B_n=K_(n,n), C_n=K_(n,n)-M_n with n>=2 and pure counting-free adjacency FO^k. Two pebbles preserve equal/edge/distinct-nonedge relative to the sole remaining pebble. Three-variable sentence detects a nonadjacent pair with no common neighbor, separating crowns. For equal capped n, permanent k-pebble partial injections preserving sides and deleted matched indices ensure unlimited-round equivalence; independent-set threshold formula separates capped indices. The 2(k-1) class count and defining width n+1 follow. Source finite refinements support but do not establish unlimited quantifiers.
